preconditions.description: The number of packages n must be between 1 and 1000.
Each package name must be a string of up to 40 non-whitespace characters.
Each package can have at most 20 dependencies.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'cannot be ordered' if any(cyclic_dependency) else True
postconditions.description: If there is a cyclic dependency, output 'cannot be ordered'.

postconditions.expression: all(package in installed_order for package in package_names)
postconditions.description: All packages must be included in the output order.

postconditions.expression: all(installed_order[i] < installed_order[j] for i in range(len(installed_order)) for j in range(i + 1, len(installed_order)) if installed_order[i] in dependencies_of(installed_order[j]))
postconditions.description: Packages must be installed in an order that respects their dependencies.
